source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Unit 4 (PDF 49-82), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 4 (Matrices & Determinants) ke poore unit se practice MCQs hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah, jis mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The word matrix was first used by the English mathematician:
(Lafz matrix sab se pehle kis English mathematician (riyazi daan) ne istemal kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Lafz matrix sab se pehle James Sylvester (1814 - 1897) ne istemal kiya; Arthur Cayley ne matrices ki theory banayi.

book_ref.quote: the word matrix was first used by the English mathematician James Sylvester

blocks.prompt:
2 Who developed the theory of matrices and used them in linear transformations?
(Matrices ki theory kis ne banayi aur unhein linear transformations mein istemal kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Arthur Cayley (1821 - 1895) ne matrices ki theory banayi aur linear transformations mein istemal ki.

book_ref.quote: developed the theory of matrices and used them in linear transformations

blocks.prompt:
3 The order of the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}3 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 4 & 5\end{bmatrix}\) is:
(Matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}3 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 4 & 5\end{bmatrix}\) ka order (darja) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is mein 2 rows (ufqi qataarein) aur 3 columns (amoodi qataarein) hain. Order mein pehle rows likhi jati hain: \(2 \times 3\).

book_ref.quote: The horizontal lines of numbers are called rows and the vertical lines of numbers are called columns

blocks.prompt:
4 In the matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}3 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 4 & 5\end{bmatrix}\), the entry \(a_{23}\) is:
(Matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}3 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 4 & 5\end{bmatrix}\) mein entry \(a_{23}\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(a_{23}\) row 2 aur column 3 mein hai. Row 2 \(0, 4, 5\) hai, is ki teesri entry \(5\) hai. (\(a_{13} = 2\), \(a_{22} = 4\), \(a_{21} = 0\).)

book_ref.quote: is the element of the \(i\)th row and the \(j\)th column of \(A\)

blocks.prompt:
5 How many entries does a matrix of order \(4 \times 5\) have?
(\(4 \times 5\) order wale matrix mein kitni entries (arkaan) hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(m \times n\) matrix mein \(m \cdot n\) entries hoti hain: \(4 \times 5 = 20\).

book_ref.quote: Note that the number of elements of the matrix in (ii) is

blocks.prompt:
6 A matrix in which the number of rows is not equal to the number of columns is called a:
(Jis matrix mein rows ki tadaad columns ki tadaad ke barabar na ho, use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Agar \(m \ne n\) ho to \(m \times n\) order ka matrix rectangular matrix (mustateel matrix) hai.

book_ref.quote: a matrix in which the number of rows is not equal to the number of columns is said to be a rectangular matrix

blocks.prompt:
7 The matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}5 & 0 \\ 0 & 5\end{bmatrix}\) is a:
(Matrix \(\begin{bmatrix}5 & 0 \\ 0 & 5\end{bmatrix}\) kis qisam ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Principal diagonal ke bahar sab entries 0 hain aur diagonal ki sab entries aik hi ghair-sifar number \(k = 5\) hain: scalar matrix. Yeh unit matrix nahi kyun ke \(5 \ne 1\).

book_ref.quote: is called a scalar matrix of order

blocks.prompt:
8 Which of the following is a diagonal matrix?
(In mein se kaun sa diagonal matrix hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diagonal matrix mein \(i \ne j\) ke liye \(a_{ij} = 0\) aur kam az kam aik diagonal entry ghair-sifar hoti hai. \(\begin{bmatrix}0 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{bmatrix}\) theek hai; null matrix nahi, kyun ke us ki sab diagonal entries 0 hain.

book_ref.quote: may be zero but not all, then the matrix

blocks.prompt:
9 The entries of the secondary diagonal of \(\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & 9\end{bmatrix}\) are:
(\(\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & 9\end{bmatrix}\) ke secondary diagonal (doosre diagonal) ki entries kaun si hain?)
blocks.explanation: Secondary diagonal \(a_{13}, a_{22}, a_{31}\) hai (oopar dayen se neeche bayen): \(3, 5, 7\). \(1, 5, 9\) principal diagonal hai.

book_ref.quote: form the secondary diagonal of

blocks.prompt:
10 A scalar matrix whose diagonal entries are all equal to \(k\) is the unit (identity) matrix when \(k\) equals:
(Scalar matrix jis ki sab diagonal entries \(k\) hon, unit (identity) matrix kab banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Unit matrix mein \(i \ne j\) ke liye \(a_{ij} = 0\) aur \(i = j\) ke liye \(a_{ij} = 1\): yani \(k = 1\) wala scalar matrix.

book_ref.quote: is called a unit matrix or identity matrix of order

blocks.prompt:
11 If \(\begin{bmatrix}x + 1 & 3 \\ 2 & y - 2\end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix}4 & 3 \\ 2 & 5\end{bmatrix}\), then:
(Agar \(\begin{bmatrix}x + 1 & 3 \\ 2 & y - 2\end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix}4 & 3 \\ 2 & 5\end{bmatrix}\) ho to:)
blocks.explanation: Barabar matrices ki mutabiq entries barabar hoti hain: \(x + 1 = 4 \Rightarrow x = 3\) aur \(y - 2 = 5 \Rightarrow y = 7\).

book_ref.quote: Two matrices of the same order are said to be equal if their corresponding entries are equal

blocks.prompt:
12 If \(A\) is a matrix of order \(2 \times 5\), then the order of \(A^{t}\) is:
(Agar \(A\) ka order \(2 \times 5\) ho to \(A^{t}\) ka order kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Transpose rows aur columns ko badal deta hai, is liye \(m \times n\) matrix \(n \times m\) ban jata hai: \(5 \times 2\).

book_ref.quote: matrix obtained by interchanging the rows and columns of

blocks.prompt:
13 A matrix whose every element is zero is called a:
(Jis matrix ka har element sifar ho, use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Square ya rectangular matrix jis ka har element sifar ho null (zero) matrix hai; is ka koi bhi order ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: A square or rectangular matrix whose every element is zero is called a null or zero matrix

blocks.prompt:
14 Two matrices are conformable for addition if they:
(Do matrices kab jama (addition) ke qabil hote hain?)

options.text: sirf rows ki tadaad barabar ho

blocks.explanation: Jama sirf aik hi order ke matrices ka hota hai. \(2 \times 3\) aur \(3 \times 2\) dono mein 6 entries hain, phir bhi jama nahi ho sakte.

book_ref.quote: Two matrices are conformable for addition if they are of the same order.

blocks.prompt:
15 If \(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & -3 \\ 1 & 4\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B = \begin{bmatrix}-1 & 5 \\ 0 & 2\end{bmatrix}\), then \(A + B\) is:
(Agar \(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & -3 \\ 1 & 4\end{bmatrix}\) aur \(B = \begin{bmatrix}-1 & 5 \\ 0 & 2\end{bmatrix}\) hon to \(A + B\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: formed by adding the corresponding entries of

blocks.prompt:
16 For the same \(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & -3 \\ 1 & 4\end{bmatrix}\) and \(B = \begin{bmatrix}-1 & 5 \\ 0 & 2\end{bmatrix}\), \(A - B\) is:
(Inhi \(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & -3 \\ 1 & 4\end{bmatrix}\) aur \(B = \begin{bmatrix}-1 & 5 \\ 0 & 2\end{bmatrix}\) ke liye \(A - B\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(A\) ki har entry mein se \(B\) ki mutabiq entry tafreeq karein: \(2 - (-1) = 3\), \(-3 - 5 = -8\), \(1 - 0 = 1\), \(4 - 2 = 2\). Pehla ghalat option \(B - A\) hai.

book_ref.quote: is formed by subtracting each entry of

blocks.prompt:
17 For matrices \(A\) and \(B\) of the same order, \(B - A\) is equal to:
(Aik hi order ke matrices \(A\) aur \(B\) ke liye \(B - A\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(A - B = [a_{ij} - b_{ij}]\) aur \(B - A = [b_{ij} - a_{ij}] = -(A - B)\). Tafreeq commutative nahi.

book_ref.quote: then we define the subtraction of

blocks.prompt:
18 \(-2\begin{bmatrix}3 & -1 \\ 0 & 5\end{bmatrix}\) equals:
(\(-2\begin{bmatrix}3 & -1 \\ 0 & 5\end{bmatrix}\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(kA = [ka_{ij}]\): har entry ko \(-2\) se zarb dein: \(-6,\ 2,\ 0,\ -10\).

book_ref.quote: is the matrix formed by multiplying each entry of

blocks.prompt:
19 For any matrix \(A\), \(A + A + A + A\) equals:
(Kisi bhi matrix \(A\) ke liye \(A + A + A + A\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(A + A + \ldots\) \(n\) terms tak \(= nA\); yahan \(n = 4\). \(A^{4}\) zarb hai, jama nahi.

book_ref.quote: is a positive integer, then

blocks.prompt:
20 If \(A\) is a \(3 \times 2\) matrix, the order of \(5A\) is:
(Agar \(A\) ka order \(3 \times 2\) ho to \(5A\) ka order kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scalar se zarb entries ko zarb karta hai, order ko nahi: \(kA\) ka order wahi \(3 \times 2\) hai.

book_ref.quote: Obviously, the order of \(kA\) is \(m \times n\).

blocks.prompt:
21 The product \(AB\) is defined when:
(Hasil-e-zarb \(AB\) kab defined hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(AB\) ke liye \(A\) ke columns ki tadaad \(B\) ki rows ki tadaad ke barabar honi chahiye.

book_ref.quote: are said to be conformable for the product

blocks.prompt:
22 If \(A\) is \(3 \times 2\) and \(B\) is \(2 \times 4\), the order of \(AB\) is:
(Agar \(A\) ka order \(3 \times 2\) aur \(B\) ka \(2 \times 4\) ho to \(AB\) ka order kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \((m \times n)(n \times p) = m \times p\): \((3 \times 2)(2 \times 4) = 3 \times 4\).

book_ref.quote: then the order of the product can be illustrated as given below

blocks.prompt:
23 If \(A\) and \(B\) are both of order \(2 \times 3\), then \(AB\):
(Agar \(A\) aur \(B\) dono \(2 \times 3\) hon to \(AB\):)
blocks.explanation: \(A\) ke 3 columns hain magar \(B\) ki 2 rows; \(3 \ne 2\), is liye \(AB\) defined nahi.

book_ref.quote: is equal to the number of rows of

blocks.prompt:
24 If \(C = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 0 & -1\end{bmatrix}\) and \(D = \begin{bmatrix}3 & 1 \\ 2 & 4\end{bmatrix}\), then \(CD\) is:
(Agar \(C = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 0 & -1\end{bmatrix}\) aur \(D = \begin{bmatrix}3 & 1 \\ 2 & 4\end{bmatrix}\) hon to \(CD\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: whose element \(c_{ij}\) is the sum of the products of the corresponding elements

blocks.prompt:
25 If \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}\), then \(A^{2}\) is:
(Agar \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}\) ho to \(A^{2}\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Powers of square matrices are defined as

blocks.prompt:
26 \(\begin{bmatrix}2 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 4\end{bmatrix}\) equals:
(\(\begin{bmatrix}2 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 4\end{bmatrix}\) kis ke barabar hai?)

book_ref.quote: Let \(A = [a_{ij}]\) be a \(2 \times 3\) matrix

blocks.text: 4.3 Properties of Matrix Addition, Scalar Multiplication and Matrix Multiplication

blocks.prompt:
27 The property \(A + B = B + A\) is called the:
(Khasiyat \(A + B = B + A\) ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(A + B = B + A\) jama ki commutative property hai; yeh is liye sahi hai ke har entry numbers ka aam jama hai.

book_ref.quote: Commutative property w.r.t. addition

blocks.prompt:
28 For conformable matrices, \(A(BC) = (AB)C\) is the:
(Qabil-e-zarb matrices ke liye \(A(BC) = (AB)C\) kaun si property hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(A(BC) = (AB)C\) zarb ki associative property hai (property vii).

book_ref.quote: Associative property w.r.t. multiplication

blocks.prompt:
29 \(A(B + C) = AB + AC\) is called the:
(\(A(B + C) = AB + AC\) ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(A\) bayen taraf rehta hai: \(A(B + C) = AB + AC\) left distributive property hai; \((A + B)C = AC + BC\) right wali hai.

book_ref.quote: Left distributive property

blocks.prompt:
30 Which of the following is NOT true in general for square matrices of the same order?
(Aik hi order ke square matrices ke liye in mein se kaun si baat aam taur par sahi NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Matrix ka zarb aam taur par commutative nahi. Maslan \(\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 \\ 0 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3 & 1 \\ 2 & 4\end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix}7 & 9 \\ -2 & -4\end{bmatrix}\) magar ulti tarteeb mein \(\begin{bmatrix}3 & 5 \\ 2 & 0\end{bmatrix}\) aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Matrix multiplication is not commutative in general.

blocks.prompt:
31 For scalars \(c, d\), the property \((c + d)A = cA + dA\) is the:
(Scalars \(c, d\) ke liye \((c + d)A = cA + dA\) kaun si property hai?)
blocks.explanation: Property (vi)(b): \((c + d)A = cA + dA\) scalar zarb ki distributive property hai; \((cd)A = c(dA)\) associative hai.

book_ref.quote: Distributive property w.r.t. scalar multiplication

blocks.prompt:
32 In \(IA = AI = A\), the matrix \(I\) is the:
(\(IA = AI = A\) mein \(I\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Unit matrix \(I\) multiplicative identity (zarbi shanakht) hai; null matrix \(O\) additive identity hai (\(A + O = A\)).

book_ref.quote: Existence of multiplicative identity

blocks.prompt:
33 The value of \(\begin{vmatrix}4 & -3 \\ 2 & 5\end{vmatrix}\) is:
(\(\begin{vmatrix}4 & -3 \\ 2 & 5\end{vmatrix}\) ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(ad - bc = 4(5) - (-3)(2) = 20 + 6 = 26\). \(20 - 6\) likhna \(-3\) ka nishan bhool jana hai.

book_ref.quote: Multiply along the leading diagonal, then subtract the product along the other diagonal

blocks.prompt:
34 A determinant is defined for:
(Determinant kis ke liye defined hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf square matrix ka determinant hota hai; \(2 \times 3\) matrix ka nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: Only a square matrix (same number of rows and columns) has a determinant

blocks.prompt:
35 If \(\begin{vmatrix}x & 2 \\ 3 & x\end{vmatrix} = 10\), then \(x\) equals:
(Agar \(\begin{vmatrix}x & 2 \\ 3 & x\end{vmatrix} = 10\) ho to \(x\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} - 6 = 10 \Rightarrow x^{2} = 16 \Rightarrow x = \pm 4\).

book_ref.quote: Every determinant of order 3 will be reduced to determinants of order 2

blocks.text: 4.4.1 Minor and Cofactor of an Element of a Matrix or its Determinant

blocks.prompt:
36 The minor \(M_{ij}\) of an element \(a_{ij}\) is the determinant formed by deleting:
(Element \(a_{ij}\) ka minor \(M_{ij}\) kya hata kar banne wala determinant hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(M_{ij}\) wo determinant hai jo \(a_{ij}\) se guzarne wali row \(i\) aur column \(j\) hata kar bachta hai.

book_ref.quote: is the determinant formed by deleting the

blocks.prompt:
37 For \(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 & 1\end{bmatrix}\), the cofactor \(A_{12}\) is:
(\(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 & 1\end{bmatrix}\) ke liye cofactor \(A_{12}\) kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: For order 3 the signs form a chessboard pattern

blocks.prompt:
38 For the same \(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 & 1\end{bmatrix}\), the minor \(M_{23}\) is:
(Isi \(A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 & 1\end{bmatrix}\) ke liye minor \(M_{23}\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Row 2 aur column 3 hatayein: \(M_{23} = \begin{vmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 1 & 4\end{vmatrix} = 8 - 1 = 7\). (Cofactor \(A_{23} = -7\) hai; minor par koi nishan nahi lagta.)

book_ref.quote: To find the minor of the element

blocks.prompt:
39 If \(i + j\) is odd, then the cofactor \(A_{ij}\) equals:
(Agar \(i + j\) taaq (odd) ho to cofactor \(A_{ij}\) kis ke barabar hai?)

book_ref.quote: The cofactor of an element

blocks.prompt:
40 How many minors does a square matrix of order 3 have?
(Order 3 ke square matrix ke kitne minors hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har element ka aik minor hota hai, aur order 3 ke matrix mein \(3 \times 3 = 9\) elements hain.

book_ref.quote: so a matrix of order 3 has 9 minors, one for each element

blocks.text: 4.4.2 Determinant of a Square Matrix of Order n = 3

blocks.prompt:
41 The value of \(\begin{vmatrix}2 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 & 1\end{vmatrix}\) is:
(\(\begin{vmatrix}2 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 & 1\end{vmatrix}\) ki qeemat kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Equation (vii) is the required expansion of determinant of square matrix of order 3.

blocks.prompt:
42 To save work, a determinant of order 3 is best expanded along the row or column that has:
(Kaam bachane ke liye order 3 ka determinant kis row ya column ke saath phailana behtar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har row aur column aik hi qeemat deta hai; sifar element ki poori term khatam ho jati hai, is liye sab se zyada sifar wali line chunein.

book_ref.quote: expand along the row or column with the most zeros

blocks.prompt:
43 Expanding along the first row, \(|A|\) equals:
(Pehli row ke saath phailane par \(|A|\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Minors ke saath row 1 ke nishan \(+, -, +\) hain (formula (v)). Cofactors ke saath sab nishan plus hain: \(a_{11}A_{11} + a_{12}A_{12} + a_{13}A_{13}\).

book_ref.quote: Similarly (i) can be written as

blocks.prompt:
44 The values of \(x\) for which \(\begin{vmatrix}x & 0 & 1 \\ 2 & x & 3 \\ 1 & 0 & x\end{vmatrix} = 0\) are:
(\(x\) ki kin qeematon ke liye \(\begin{vmatrix}x & 0 & 1 \\ 2 & x & 3 \\ 1 & 0 & x\end{vmatrix} = 0\) hai?)
blocks.explanation: Column 2 ke saath phailayein (do sifar): sirf \(a_{22} = x\) bachta hai, \(x\begin{vmatrix}x & 1 \\ 1 & x\end{vmatrix} = x(x^{2} - 1) = 0\), to \(x = 0, 1, -1\).

book_ref.quote: a zero element makes its whole term vanish

blocks.prompt:
45 For a square matrix \(A\), \(|A^{t}|\) equals:
(Square matrix \(A\) ke liye \(|A^{t}|\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Property i: \(|A| = |A^{t}|\); transpose se determinant nahi badalta.

book_ref.quote: Transposing: value unchanged

blocks.prompt:
46 If two rows of a square matrix \(A\) are interchanged, the new determinant is:
(Agar square matrix \(A\) ki do rows aapas mein badal di jayein to naya determinant kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Property ii: do rows (ya do columns) badalne se nishan badal jata hai: \(-|A|\).

book_ref.quote: two rows or two columns are interchanged, the determinant of the resulting matrix is

blocks.prompt:
47 The value of \(\begin{vmatrix}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & 4 & 6 \\ 5 & 7 & 9\end{vmatrix}\) is:
(\(\begin{vmatrix}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & 4 & 6 \\ 5 & 7 & 9\end{vmatrix}\) ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(R_{2} = 2R_{1}\). \(R_{2}\) se 2 bahar nikalne par (property v) do aik jaisi rows bachti hain, is liye qeemat 0 hai (property iii).

book_ref.quote: has two identical rows or two identical columns, then

blocks.prompt:
48 If \(|A| = 5\) and every entry of one row of \(A\) is multiplied by 3, the new determinant is:
(Agar \(|A| = 5\) ho aur \(A\) ki aik row ki har entry ko 3 se zarb dein to naya determinant kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Property v: aik row ko \(k\) se zarb dene par \(k|A| = 3(5) = 15\). (\(135\) to \(|3A| = 27|A|\) hota.)

book_ref.quote: are multiplied by a number

blocks.prompt:
49 If \(A\) is a square matrix of order 3 with \(|A| = 4\), then \(|2A|\) is:
(Agar \(A\) order 3 ka square matrix ho aur \(|A| = 4\) ho to \(|2A|\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(2A\) teeno rows ko 2 se zarb deta hai, is liye \(|2A| = 2^{3}|A| = 8 \times 4 = 32\). Sirf aik baar 2 nikalna ghalat jawab 8 deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Taking \(k\) out of the whole matrix

blocks.prompt:
50 The value of \(\begin{vmatrix}2 & 7 & -1 \\ 0 & -3 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 4\end{vmatrix}\) is:
(\(\begin{vmatrix}2 & 7 & -1 \\ 0 & -3 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 4\end{vmatrix}\) ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh upper triangular hai, is liye determinant main diagonal ki entries ka hasil-e-zarb hai: \(2 \times (-3) \times 4 = -24\).

book_ref.quote: If a matrix is in triangular form, then the value of its determinant is the product of the entries on its main diagonal.

blocks.prompt:
51 The operation \(R_{2} + 3R_{1} \to R_{2}\) changes the value of a determinant \(|A|\) to:
(Amal \(R_{2} + 3R_{1} \to R_{2}\) determinant \(|A|\) ki qeemat ko kya bana deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Property vii: aik row ka \(k\) guna doosri row mein jama karne se determinant nahi badalta.

book_ref.quote: the value of the determinant does not change

blocks.prompt:
52 If every entry of the third column of a square matrix \(A\) of order 3 is zero, then \(|A|\) is:
(Agar order 3 ke square matrix \(A\) ke teesre column ki har entry sifar ho to \(|A|\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Property iv: sifar column ke saath phailayein; har term mein 0 ka factor hai, is liye \(|A| = 0\).

book_ref.quote: If all the entries of a row (or a column) of a square matrix

blocks.text: 4.5 Adjoint and Inverse of a Square Matrix

blocks.prompt:
53 The adjoint \(\operatorname{adj} A\) of a square matrix \(A\) is:
(Square matrix \(A\) ka adjoint \(\operatorname{adj} A\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\operatorname{adj} A\) cofactors ke matrix ka transpose hai: \(A\) ki row 1 ke cofactors \(\operatorname{adj} A\) ke column 1 mein aate hain.

book_ref.quote: is the transpose of the matrix of cofactors. The cofactors of row 1

blocks.prompt:
54 A square matrix \(A\) has a multiplicative inverse if and only if:
(Square matrix \(A\) ka multiplicative inverse (zarbi maakoos) kab hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(A^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{|A|}\operatorname{adj} A\) mein \(|A|\) se taqseem hai, is liye \(A\) non-singular hona chahiye: \(|A| \ne 0\).

book_ref.quote: is called the multiplicative inverse of

blocks.prompt:
55 The values of \(k\) for which \(\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & k & 4 \\ 1 & 1 & k\end{bmatrix}\) is singular are:
(\(k\) ki kin qeematon par \(\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & k & 4 \\ 1 & 1 & k\end{bmatrix}\) singular hai?)

book_ref.quote: is called singular and has no inverse

blocks.prompt:
56 For a square matrix \(A\) of order 3, \(A(\operatorname{adj} A)\) equals:
(Order 3 ke square matrix \(A\) ke liye \(A(\operatorname{adj} A)\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har diagonal entry aik row ko us ke apne cofactors se zarb \(= |A|\); baqi entries 0. Is liye \(A(\operatorname{adj} A) = |A|\,I\).

book_ref.quote: Multiply \(A\) by \(\operatorname{adj} A\).

blocks.prompt:
57 If \(|A| = -1\), then \(A^{-1}\) equals:
(Agar \(|A| = -1\) ho to \(A^{-1}\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(A^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{|A|}\operatorname{adj} A = \dfrac{1}{-1}\operatorname{adj} A = -\operatorname{adj} A\): adjoint ki har entry ka nishan badal jata hai.

book_ref.quote: It is obvious that the order of

blocks.prompt:
58 For \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & 4\end{bmatrix}\), \(|A| = 1\). The entry in row 1, column 2 of \(A^{-1}\) is:
(\(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & 4\end{bmatrix}\) ke liye \(|A| = 1\). \(A^{-1}\) ki row 1, column 2 wali entry kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\operatorname{adj} A\) ki row 1, column 2 cofactor \(A_{21} = -\begin{vmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 3 & 4\end{vmatrix} = -(8 - 3) = -5\) hai; \(|A| = 1\) se taqseem. (\(A_{12} = 2\) transpose bhoolne ki ghalti hai.)

book_ref.quote: Write the matrix of cofactors and take its transpose

blocks.text: 4.6 Elementary Row Operations on a Matrix

blocks.prompt:
59 Which of the following is NOT an elementary row operation?
